subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, an explicit backed-up doctor/reset repair, or automatic load-time quarantine?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects persisted session continuity and operator trust, so automation should not choose the destructive recovery policy.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
options.body: Status and doctor report file path, size, parse/schema status, and offer a backed-up reset or doctor repair command that the operator explicitly runs.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status and doctor identify the bad artifact and recovery steps, but all mutation remains manual operator action.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Gateway load moves invalid state aside and recreates clean state automatically, accepting the risk of surprising session continuity loss.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
recommendation.body: Status and doctor report file path, size, parse/schema status, and offer a backed-up reset or doctor repair command that the operator explicitly runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin/channel status behavior and core state-repair policy, and steipete has relevant plugin boundary history.
